discription: A simple Frequency Modulation bass synth with an ADSR envelope and adjustable modulation.
code: { arg out=0, freq=50, amp=0.2, gate=1, carRatio=1, modRatio=0.9, modIndex=10; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.6, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio, 0, freq * modIndex * env); var car = SinOsc.ar(freq * carRatio + mod); Out.ar(out, (car * amp * env) ! 2); }
